searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he ein sof captions — phase one: unbounded revelation the awtsmoos hides infinite visual possibility inside one quiet point of light; awtsmoos.com should let the user summon complexity only when the moment is right. what the existing engine really is the 893 line root captions document is not a simple caption form. it is a local 1080×1920 generative visual compositor with: batch captions; optional headers; box color/opacity/padding/radius; hebrew particle fields; fragmented/full glyph modes; three connection algorithms; base background color; film grain; bloom; per property randomization ranges; indexeddb persistence; optional file system access directory output; web worker rendering; layered nebula/star backgrounds; bloom maps; text fitting; chromatic aberration; vignette/grain; and jpeg downloads. the problem is not missing capability. the problem is revelation order: every capability is visible at once, the 500px control wall competes with a fixed 540×960 preview, advanced controls are always expanded, randomization toggles are unlabeled decorative glyph spans, the generate button pulses forever, status flickers forever, and several renderer helpers are compressed into unreadable one line functions. ideal interaction universe preview dominates the screen; controls become a retractable studio rail. on desktop the rail is resizable looking but fixed in purpose, with a single collapse control. on mobile the rail becomes a full height off canvas drawer; preview remains usable behind it. “essentials” stays open: caption batch, header, generate, save destination. “caption vessel” is a retractable group for box appearance. “particle field” retracts density/size/style/characters. “connections” retracts network type/density. “atmosphere” retracts background/grain/bloom. every randomized property has a small real button labeled randomize; activating it reveals min/max controls only for that property. generation feedback is a calm progress rail/status chip, not an infinite flicker. a generation button can have one restrained sheen on hover/focus, never continuous motion. preview uses a bounded aspect ratio vessel with actual canvas scaling, never a fixed viewport breaking box. controls use compact two column rows where safe and one column on narrow screens. all forms have visible focus and practical touch targets. reduced motion disables reveal transforms and canvas shell micro motion. batch generation and file system output remain intact. user settings remain persisted under the same indexeddb database/store/version so existing saved values survive. worker rendering remains off main thread. extreme architecture possibilities a. keep worker inline and only split ui — rejected because the worker contains minified functions and keeps the monolith hidden inside html. b. move all worker logic to one 400 line worker file — rejected by the 120 line law. c. module worker with small rendering modules — winner: clean imports, testable pure helpers, no inline blob construction. d. move rendering to main thread — rejected because particle/network/postprocessing work can block interaction. e. reuse /captions/video/ renderer — rejected because it is a different product contract and would risk collapsing two distinct tools. phase one behavioral preservation canvas internal resolution remains 1080×1920. blank caption input still yields one blank vision rather than hard failure. paragraphs split on blank lines for batch output. all existing controls/default values remain represented. randomized colors remain random hex colors; numeric ranges honor min/max and range step semantics. worker still emits progress/result/complete messages. jpeg quality remains 0.92. directory picker remains optional when supported, with download fallback. file naming retains bh einsof .jpg semantics. existing indexeddb name/store/version remain einsofenginedb, settingsstore, version 2.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he ein sof captions — phase two: gevurah boundaries the awtsmoos gives infinite light through finite vessels that do not fight; awtsmoos.com must preserve the renderer while making every control feel light. concrete source defects 1. one 893 line html file owns markup, styling, rendering algorithms, persistence, worker bootstrap, download logic, ui binding, and business state. 2. several worker helpers are one line compressed functions, making maintenance and verification unsafe. 3. controls are permanently 500px wide and the preview permanently 540×960 before the lone broad breakpoint. 4. the mobile fallback simply stacks a 95vw control wall above a 95vw×1.7777 preview, so the first meaningful preview can require enormous scrolling. 5. advanced settings are always visible; users must traverse every particle/network/effect setting before the primary action. 6. randomization uses emoji spans without button semantics or accessible pressed state. 7. continuous pulse and flicker animations compete with the creative preview. 8. no reduced motion policy exists. 9. status uses display mutation rather than a stable accessible state region. 10. generate has no clear batch count/progress fraction outside textual worker messages. 11. the worker is created from an inline script blob, preventing normal module inspection, caching, and composition. 12. storage code serializes every element with an id, including unrelated display elements, instead of a defined control set. architectural boundaries markup index.html — shell only, <=120 lines. css css/tokens.css — palette, dimensions, semantic layers. css/base.css — reset, typography, focus, accessibility utilities. css/shell.css — app grid, studio rail, preview stage. css/panels.css — native retractable details sections. css/controls.css — inputs, sliders, randomize buttons, action bar. css/preview.css — canvas frame, status overlay. css/responsive.css — mobile drawer and narrow layouts. css/motion.css — short transitions and reduced motion overrides. main thread js js/klieinsofdom.js — required dom vessels. js/ohrcontrolmanifest.js — explicit setting ids/types/default semantics. js/chesedsettingsstore.js — indexeddb persistence using existing db contract. js/gevurahstudiodrawer.js — desktop collapse + mobile drawer state. js/tiferesrandomization.js — pressed buttons + min/max reveal/state. js/netzachsettingscollector.js — renderer payload assembly. js/hoddownloadmanager.js — directory picker/download fallback. js/yesodrendercoordinator.js — module worker lifecycle and progress. js/malchuspreview.js — canvas display and initial state. js/app.js — composition root only. worker modules worker/ein sof worker.js — receives job, loops captions, emits messages. worker/boreholam.js — orchestration. worker/olambackground.js — starfield/nebula/shooting star background. worker/yetzirahparticles.js — particle universe + glyph render. worker/kavnetwork.js — web/arcs/synapse connections. worker/tiferestext.js — text fit, box blur, border, corner b\"h. worker/hodpost.js — bloom and post processing. worker/ohrpalette.js — palette and color conversion. worker/chesedrandom.js — random numbers/colors/settings resolution. preserve / improve line preserve renderer visuals and defaults where practical. simplify the surrounding ui radically. do not silently remove an advanced parameter just because it is hidden behind a disclosure. do not change persistence keys. do not make directory access mandatory. do not move expensive pixel processing onto the main thread. verification graph every source file <=120 lines. every js module parses. worker module dependency graph resolves. all manifest controls exist in dom. desktop 1440×900: preview dominates, no page horizontal overflow, rail retracts. mobile 390×844 and 320×568: preview visible before enormous scrolling; studio drawer opens/closes and body does not overflow horizontally. all advanced panels are native keyboard accessible disclosures. randomize controls expose aria pressed and min/max only when active. existing indexeddb settings load without exceptions. worker can render a low complexity synthetic job and send result/complete. canvas result appears and a download path is invoked only by explicit generation.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he ein sof captions — phase three: final file revelation the awtsmoos is infinite yet never cluttered, hidden yet never gone; awtsmoos.com should let advanced power unfold by choice, then quietly move on. final critique of earlier plans the first pass risked making “retractable” mean merely wrapping the old control wall in a drawer. that is not enough. the final design must change information hierarchy, interaction semantics, motion intensity, mobile ordering, and architecture at the same time while preserving every renderer parameter and storage key. final improvements 1. make preview the first visual priority in dom reading order after the compact top bar. 2. keep only caption text/header and generate visibly immediate. 3. use native for advanced groups instead of custom disclosure code. 4. default advanced groups closed; keep essentials open. 5. give each disclosure a short human subtitle so kabbalistic names remain evocative without obscuring purpose. 6. replace every randomize emoji span with an actual button carrying aria pressed. 7. randomization ranges appear only while pressed. 8. persist randomization state under the exact existing randomize active keys. 9. persist only known controls from an explicit manifest rather than every id in the document. 10. keep the same indexeddb database/store/version. 11. keep renderer settings names exactly compatible with the old worker. 12. module worker replaces inline blob worker. 13. preserve 1080×1920 internal render resolution. 14. preview scales responsively by aspect ratio and never drives document width. 15. desktop control rail retracts to a compact 58px edge. 16. mobile control rail becomes an off canvas sheet with backdrop. 17. generate action remains reachable at the bottom through a sticky action shelf inside the rail. 18. no continuously pulsing/flickering chrome. 19. use only short <=180ms opacity/translate transitions. 20. honor reduced motion. 21. keep status visible via aria live and a stable overlay/chip. 22. show batch progress as calm text from worker messages. 23. disable generate only during a real render job. 24. directory picker only appears when supported. 25. directory cancellation returns ui to ready state without fake error drama. 26. keep download fallback and filename contract. 27. keep b\"h and ב\"ה corner marks after post processing. 28. keep cosmic background, hero stars, nebulae, meteors, particles, networks, bloom, text box, grain/vignette/chromatic aberration. 29. rewrite compressed helper functions into readable multiline modules. 30. keep every new source file <=120 lines without reducing documentation. exact files to write html: apps/captions/index.html css: apps/captions/css/tokens.css
